Phone receives {doxing_password, sar_id, static_doxing_data} from User. The
single SarId contains the selected SAR's Tor address and public key.
StaticDoxingData contains the user's name, national ID, home and work addresses, mobile, home, and work phone
numbers, and a trusted person's name, address, and phone number.
DynamicDoxingData contains a schema identifier, capture time, and payload such as location. Phone
NFC-normalizes doxing_password and encodes it as UTF-8 bytes, then saves doxing_key as
tagged_sha256("Boomerang/doxing_key", doxing_password_bytes). It takes sar_pubkey from sar_id, obtains its
canonical public-key bytes, derives doxing_key_for_sar as
That SAR-specific key encrypts the user's static and dynamic doxing data, and the identifier initializes the
SAR receives doxing_data_identifier from Phone, generates a service-fee
invoice for this registration, sets its payment deadline, and creates SarServiceFeePaymentInfo containing that
deadline, and the SAR's configured SarId. It retains the identifier as the lookup key for this pending
registration and returns the payment information to Phone.
Phone receives sar_service_fee_payment_info from SAR, checks that its SarId
equals the selected sar_id, and forwards it to User.
User receives sar_service_fee_payment_info from Phone, verifies its SAR
identity, invoice, and deadline, and pays it. Each resulting ServicePaymentReceipt contains the service
identifier, invoice reference, and payment proof.
User inputs the SAR payment receipts back to Phone.
Phone receives sar_service_fee_payment_receipts from User. For static and
dynamic data it derives separate CBC and CMAC keys from doxing_key_for_sar with "Boomerang/sar_stored_data".
It encrypts static_doxing_data with canonical context {"sar_static_data", doxing_data_identifier} and
{"sar_dynamic_data", doxing_data_identifier}. cbc_cmac_encrypt produces a CbcCmacEnvelope containing version,
Phone sends the static envelope once and sends updated dynamic envelopes at intervals, each accompanied by the
unauthenticated doxing_data_identifier lookup key and the payment receipts.
note that static data is sent once and dynamic data is updated and sent in intervals
Phone sends doxing_data_identifier alongside every sent message as an unauthenticated lookup identifier.
dynamic_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar} from Phone. It requires verify_payment to succeed and the
identifier to equal the value received during initialization.
It stores the encrypted static and dynamic data under that identifier and confirms synchronization. Phone
continues sending newly captured encrypted DynamicDoxingData at intervals.

Phone and proceeds to setup Iso.
Iso receives {network, account, key_index, entropy_bytes, passphrase,
doxing_password, sar_id} from User. It creates mnemonic from entropy_bytes, derives master_xpriv_0, and
m/52102'/coin_type'/account'/0/key_index. coin_type is 0 for mainnet and 1 for testnet, signet, and regtest;
account and key_index default to 0. It derives normal_pubkey_0 from normal_privkey_0.
Iso NFC-normalizes doxing_password and encodes it as UTF-8 bytes, then derives doxing_key as
tagged_sha256("Boomerang/doxing_key", doxing_password_bytes) for installation into Boomlet. It retains
mnemonic, passphrase, sar_id, and the derived normal-key material for the remainder of this Iso session.
coin_type := 0 if network is mainnet else 1
Boomlet receives {normal_pubkey_0, doxing_key, sar_id} from Iso during
installation. It generates an identity private key and derives boomlet_0_identity_pubkey,
generates a MuSig2 private share and derives its public share, and combines that public share with
normal_pubkey_0 to derive boom_pubkey_0. Computing the aggregate key during installation validates the MuSig2
share and normal public key before setup continues.
After successful installation on an empty smart card, Boomlet returns boomlet_0_identity_pubkey to Iso.
Iso receives boomlet_0_identity_pubkey from Boomlet and forwards it to ST.
ST receives boomlet_0_identity_pubkey from Iso, generates a new identity
private key, derives st_0_identity_pubkey, retains the private key, and returns the public key.
Iso receives st_0_identity_pubkey from ST and forwards it to Boomlet.
